transcribed_question:
a) Identify the prominence marked blue
b) What muscle is attached to the area marked B?
c) The body of the 5th Vertebrae is thus type is the Largest T/F

marker.description: Blue paint mark on the transverse process

main_explanation: The blue paint is applied to the lateral projection of the vertebral arch, which is the transverse process. In lumbar vertebrae, this is a slender, pointed process.

supporting_question.question: Which muscle is attached to the tip of the transverse process of the lumbar vertebrae?
supporting_question.explanation: The quadratus lumborum muscle attaches to the tips of the lumbar transverse processes and the iliac crest.

true_false.statement: The body of the 5th lumbar vertebra is the largest in the vertebral column.
true_false.explanation: Lumbar vertebral bodies increase in size from L1 to L5 to support increasing weight, making L5 the largest.
